title: Team Review Status Envelope
description: Wire format for every /team:review return — plugin path and multi-host fallback alike. Extends the subagent-status.json frame (same status enum, same NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED semantics) with review findings, the reviewed ref, and quota visibility. Emitted by src/scripts/ai_team/team_dispatch.ts; contract prose in docs/contracts/ai-team-config.md.

status.description: DONE = review ran, no findings above info. DONE_WITH_CONCERNS = review ran and findings[] needs the caller's attention, OR the model output was unparseable (raw carries the verbatim text — never silently dropped). NEEDS_CONTEXT = reviewer lacks context beyond the bundle; blocking_question must be answered. BLOCKED = no review was produced (auth, quota, transport); blocking_reason describes why.

findings.description: Review findings. Empty for a clean DONE and for BLOCKED (no review happened).

severity.description: critical = data loss / security / correctness on the main path. major = real defect, wrong under realistic input. minor = defect on an edge path or maintainability trap. info = observation, no action required.

evidence.description: What is wrong, citing the exact hunk/line from the reviewed diff — never invented code.

reviewed_ref.description: HEAD sha the repo-context bundle was built from — pins what was actually reviewed.

model.description: Reviewer model id, or the literal 'auto' when the codex CLI default was used (no --model flag passed).

quota.description: Shared cli_call_budget bucket visibility after this run. The bucket is named rather than assumed — `provider` says which one `used` counts.

provider.description: The shared-bucket key this run books into, read from the dispatching client rather than hardcoded. Was implicitly always `openai`; naming it keeps the report from drifting away from the bucket if the team transport moves.

used.description: Today's call count in the `provider` bucket (UTC-day, shared with the council).

ceiling.description: ai_team.max_calls_per_day — the team-side ceiling on the shared bucket.

raw.description: Verbatim model output, present ONLY when the findings contract could not be parsed (status is then DONE_WITH_CONCERNS). Preserved so a malformed review is loud, never dropped.

blocking_question.description: Single specific question whose answer would unblock. Required when status = NEEDS_CONTEXT.

blocking_reason.description: Why no review was produced (auth_expired → codex login, cli_quota_exhausted, transport error). Required when status = BLOCKED.
